types.Cached: EnumerationExpandableIndex.Cached Symbol Constraint, fields core : EnumerationState.State Symbol Constraint; expandable : Nat → Bool; waiting : EnumerationWaitingIndex.Waiting
types.candidate: (heap : InternedConstructorTemplates.State Symbol Constraint) → EnumerationState.UVarValue Symbol → Option Bool
types.List.map_eq_nil_iff: {f : α → β} {l : List α} : List.map f l = [] ↔ l = []
types.List.map_eq_singleton_iff: {f : α → β} {l : List α} {b : β} : List.map f l = [b] ↔ ∃ a, l = [a] ∧ f a = b
types.Option.bind_some: (a) (f : α → Option β) : (some a).bind f = f a
types.Option.bind_none: (f : α → Option β) : none.bind f = none
types.Option.map_some: (a) (f : α → β) : (some a).map f = some (f a)
types.Except.map: (f : α → β) → Except ε α → Except ε β; errors are retained
types.congrArg: {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} {a₁ a₂ : α} (f : α → β) (h : a₁ = a₂) : f a₁ = f a₂
types.funext: {α : Sort u} {β : α → Sort v} {f g : (x : α) → β x} (h : ∀ x, f x = g x) : f = g

warning: Raw map erases expandable/waiting fields and is not injective on Cached. map_eq_singleton_iff supplies shape and projected equality only. Use actual producer final flags/waiting to recover cache equality. No Cached.ext theorem is required.
